# MDD Sim Gateway v1.9.3

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- **本版本只有修复，没有功能变化。**四条来自实机日志和外部贡献者的报告：控制面在 AMI 连接
  被拒后会一直刷日志、ModemManager 读不出 ICCID 时短信与通话找不到线路、ML307X 切换配置后
  读卡器槽位错乱，以及两处只在特定环境下才暴露的配置缺口。
- **本版本改动了 Engine。**升级时必须同时更新 Control 与 Engine 镜像，不能只替换控制面；
  手动升级请执行 `sudo ./install.sh reload`，不要加 `--no-engines`。
- **本版本暂不开放自动安装。**自动更新通道仍保持在 v1.9.1，v1.9.2 与本版本都需要手动升级。
  待实机验证确认后再开放。
- **全新安装会多装一个系统包** `mobile-broadband-provider-info`（运营商 APN 数据库），
  已安装的设备升级时由 `install.sh` 补齐。

### 1. v1.9.3 本次小版本更新

**控制面**

- **AMI 连接被拒后，日志会一直刷发送失败，直到控制面重启。** panoramisk 在创建 Manager 时
  就挂上了心跳与重连定时器，事件循环通过这两个回调一直持有该对象，所以连接失败的 Manager
  不会被回收，而是每个心跳周期报一次发送失败——实机上一次 16:44 的被拒连接到 18:11 还在写
  日志。现在失败路径会关闭自己的 Manager。升级本身就足以触发它：控制面重启时引擎容器往往
  还没起来。这不是 v1.9.2 引入的回归，只是升级提供了那次重启。
- **ModemManager 读不出这张 SIM 的 ICCID 时，短信与通话匹配不到线路。** 现在这种情况下可以
  按 IMSI 匹配。能读到但对不上的 ICCID 仍然按不匹配处理，不会退化成用 IMSI 兜底。
- **ML307X 线路切换配置后读卡器槽位错乱。** 切换 eSIM 配置后，已分配的 PIN、SWu、IMS 三个
  槽位会丢失重排，多出来的未分配 VPCD 读卡器会被算进去，模块不上报 IMEI 时线路上已配置的
  IMEI 也会被清掉。现在三者都保留。（[#74](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/74)）

**引擎**

- **按 IMSI 匹配到读卡器后重选 ADF.USIM 会失败。** 一处调用了不存在的辅助函数；另外重选没有
  走统一的 APDU 交换，TPDU 级读卡器返回的 `61xx` 不会去取响应，而是留给下一条命令，导致后续
  时序错位。现在都走共用的交换路径。（[#74](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/74)）

**安装与网络**

- **在控制面上设置 `SWU_TUN_MTU` 对线路没有任何效果。** 引擎一直会读这个变量来固定 `ipsec0`
  的 MTU，但控制面启动容器时只传了实例 id 和心跳周期，所以为会分片的运营商调低 MTU 只对手工
  起的容器有用。现在这个变量会透传给控制面管理的容器。
  （[#79](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/79)）
- **全新安装后蜂窝数据可能拨不上。** 模块没有可见的承载 APN 时，拨号配置会回退到
  `gsm.auto-config yes`，而这个查询要读运营商数据库；系统里没有 `mobile-broadband-provider-info`
  时 NetworkManager 拿不到 APN，数据连接就起不来。安装脚本现在会装上这个包。
  （[#80](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/80)）

### 2. v1.9 功能概览

- SIM 访问支持 APDU-level 响应的读卡器与 T=1 卡，覆盖 SELECT 与 READ 全流程。
- 国家出口选择器可按中英文国家名与两位国家代码搜索，并支持键盘选择。
- 重命名运行中的 SIM 线路不再重建 IKE 与 Asterisk 引擎；改动运行参数仍会重启线路以生效。
- 手动更新可在最近五个正式版本中选择，便于回退或切换版本。
- 换出口的判定只在隧道于网络层得不到应答时归咎于出口；运营商侧的授权拒绝不再换节点
  （v1.9.2 起）。

本版本需要同时更新 Control 与 Engine。Engine 的 SIM 读取代码有变更，发布流程会为 arm64
和 amd64 重新构建并校验镜像。

---

## English

### 0. Important notes

- **This release is fixes only, with no behaviour or feature changes.** Four reports from real
  hardware logs and outside contributors: the control plane logging forever after a refused
  AMI connection, SMS and calls finding no line when ModemManager cannot read the ICCID,
  ML307X reader slots shuffling after a profile switch, and two configuration gaps that only
  surface in particular environments.
- **The engine changed in this release.** Update Control and Engine together; for a manual
  upgrade run `sudo ./install.sh reload` without `--no-engines`.
- **Automatic installation stays closed.** The auto-update channels remain on v1.9.1, so both
  v1.9.2 and this release must be installed manually. The channels move once this is confirmed
  on real hardware.
- **A fresh install now pulls in one more system package**, `mobile-broadband-provider-info`
  (the carrier APN database). Existing installs get it from `install.sh` on upgrade.

### 1. Fixed in v1.9.3

**Control plane**

- **A refused AMI connection logged a send failure forever, until the control plane
  restarted.** panoramisk schedules a pinger and a reconnect timer as soon as a Manager
  exists, and the event loop keeps the object reachable through those callbacks, so a Manager
  whose connect failed was never collected — it reported a send failure once per ping
  interval. On the Pi, one refused connect at 16:44 was still writing log lines at 18:11. The
  failure path now closes its own Manager. An upgrade is enough to reach it: the control plane
  restarts while the engine containers are still starting. This is not a v1.9.2 regression;
  the upgrade only supplied the restart that exposed it.
- **SMS and calls matched no line when ModemManager could not read that SIM's ICCID.** They
  can now match by IMSI in that case. A readable but different ICCID still fails closed
  instead of falling back to IMSI.
- **ML307X reader slots shuffled after a profile switch.** Switching eSIM profiles lost and
  reordered the allocated PIN, SWu and IMS slots, counted extra unallocated VPCD readers, and
  cleared a line's configured IMEI when the modem did not expose one live. All three are now
  retained ([#74](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/74)).

**Engine**

- **Reselecting ADF.USIM after an IMSI-bound reader match failed.** One path called a helper
  that does not exist, and the reselect did not go through the shared APDU exchange, so a
  TPDU-level reader's `61xx` was left pending for the next command instead of being fetched —
  putting the following exchanges out of step. Both now use the shared path
  ([#74](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/74)).

**Installation and networking**

- **Setting `SWU_TUN_MTU` on the control plane had no effect on any line.** The engine has
  always read that variable to fix the `ipsec0` MTU, but the control plane passed a managed
  container only its instance id and liveness period, so lowering the MTU for a carrier that
  fragments only worked for a container started by hand. The variable is now passed through
  ([#79](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/79)).
- **Cellular data could fail to come up after a fresh install.** With no bearer APN visible,
  the modem profile falls back to `gsm.auto-config yes`, and that lookup reads the carrier
  database; without `mobile-broadband-provider-info` NetworkManager had no APN to dial. The
  installer now installs the package
  ([#80](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/pull/80)).

### 2. v1.9 feature overview

- SIM access supports APDU-level readers and T=1 cards across SELECT and READ.
- The country exit picker searches by English and Chinese country names and two-letter codes,
  with keyboard selection.
- Renaming a running SIM line no longer rebuilds the IKE and Asterisk engines; changing runtime
  parameters still restarts the line so they take effect.
- Manual updates can select any of the last five official releases, for rollback or switching.
- Exit attribution blames the node only for a tunnel that went unanswered on the network;
  carrier-side authorization refusals no longer move the node (since v1.9.2).

This release updates Control and Engine together. The engine's SIM-reading code changed, so
the release workflow rebuilds and verifies both arm64 and amd64 images.
